parts.text: A student investigates the position of the image in a plane mirror. Fig. 3.1 shows the ray-trace sheet he uses. Fig. 3.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) • The student draws the line MR . • He draws a normal NL to this line that passes through the centre of MR . • He labels the point at which NL crosses MR with the letter B . • He draws a line from B at an angle of incidence i = 30° to the normal below MR and to the left of the normal. He labels the end of this line A . • He places a pin P 1 on line AB , as shown in Fig. 3.1. He places another pin P 2 on the line AB . • He places the reflecting face of the mirror vertically on the line MR . • He views the images of pins P 1 and P 2 from the direction indicated by the eye in Fig. 3.1.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) On Fig. 3.1, mark with a cross a suitable position for pin P 2 in this experiment. [1] • He places two pins P 3 and P 4 some distance apart so that pin P 3 and the images of P 2 and P 1 all appear exactly behind pin P 4 . The positions of P 3 and P 4 are shown on Fig. 3.1.

ms.label: 3(a)(i)
ms.text: P2 at least 5.0 cm from P1

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Draw the line joining the positions of P 3 and P 4 . Continue the line until it extends at least 7.0 cm beyond MR . [2]

ms.label: 3(a)(ii)
ms.text:
Straight line joining pin positions
Extended at least 7 cm behind mirror

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) • The student keeps pin P 1 in the same position but moves pin P 2 so that the angle of incidence i = 40°. • The pin positions P 5 and P 6 for the reflected ray are marked on Fig. 3.1.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Draw the line joining the positions of P 5 and P 6 . Continue the line until it extends at least 7.0 cm beyond MR . Label with the letter Y the point where the two lines cross beyond MR . [1]

ms.label: 3(b)(i)
ms.text: Correct line and correct position of Y labelled

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Draw a line from P 1 to MR that meets MR at a right angle. Measure and record the length a of this line. a = ..................................................... [1]

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Draw a line from the point labelled Y to MR that meets MR at a right angle. Measure and record the length b of this line. b = ..................................................... [1]

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) • The student removes all the pins. He places pin P 7 on the normal at a distance 6.0 cm from the front of the mirror. • He views the image of P 7 in the mirror. • He places pin P 8 on the normal behind the mirror. • He adjusts the position of P 8 so that the image of the bottom of the pin P 7 and the top of pin P 8 seen over the mirror appear as one pin when viewed from all angles in front of the mirror.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) On Fig. 3.1, measure the distance x along the normal between P 8 and the mirror. x = ..................................................... [1]

ms.label: 3(c)(i)
ms.text: Correct x measured and correct unit seen at a, b or x and not contradicted

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Complete the diagram in Fig. 3.2 to show the appearance of the image of pin P 7 and pin P 8 as described in (c) . Fig. 3.2 [1]

ms.label: 3(c)(ii)
ms.text: Diagram to show image in mirror meeting top of pin above mirror

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) The student expects the readings to show that the image formed in a plane mirror is the same distance behind the mirror as the object is in front of the mirror. Readings of a = b and x = 6.0 cm will show this. State whether your readings show that the image formed in a plane mirror is the same distance behind the mirror as the object is in front of the mirror. Justify your statement by reference to the readings. statement .................................................................................................................................. justification ................................................................................................................................ ................................................................................................................................................... [2]

ms.label: 3(d)
ms.text:
Statement to match results
Justification to match statement with correct reference to results

ms.label: 3(e)
ms.text:
Any one from:
Thickness to mirror
Thickness of lines
Difficulty in judging exact lining up of pins.
